name: ag.org
body: Every external link that was checked answered, and AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page. But links must have discernible text.
lesson: Give every link text that says where it goes. An icon alone needs an aria-label.
summary: The site's bot protection refused the plain request and headless Chrome while it carried the review tag; the page was analyzed in headless Chrome without the tag. Partial analysis: 19 of 19 linked pages answered with a bot check or a block, so the scores rest mostly on the start page. ag.org scores 60 out of 100 (D). 8 checks fail now, 33 are at risk, and 28 pass. Fix first: buttons must have…

fix.title: Buttons must have discernible text
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 14 elements on /, for example .center-col > form[action="/Components/Search/SearchIndex"] > .btn-inline[type="submit"] and .card-slider-featurednews > .owl-nav > .owl-prev[type="button"]. Impact: critical.
fix.fix: Give each icon button visible text or an aria-label.

fix.title: Links must have discernible text
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 61 elements on /, for example a[target="_blank"]:nth-child(1) and a[href$="ag_usa"][target="_blank"]:nth-child(2). Impact: serious.
fix.fix: Give each link text, or an aria-label when it only holds an icon.

fix.title: 53 images have no alt attribute
fix.fix: Describe informative images. Give decorative ones alt="".

fix.title: HSTS is not sent
fix.evidence: strict-transport-security was absent on the start page. A first visit over http can be intercepted.

fix.title: 2 form controls have no label
fix.evidence: On /. Screen readers announce them as an unnamed field.
fix.fix: Pair each control with <label for>, wrap it in a label, or add aria-label.

fix.title: The viewport stops people from zooming
fix.evidence: The viewport tag sets user-scalable=no or maximum-scale=1.
fix.fix: Remove user-scalable=no and maximum-scale from the viewport tag.

AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
Front-end libraries have no known flaw
The start page declares its language
Core Web Vitals pass for real visitors
The start page sets a mobile viewport
